name: Ushijima
excerpt: Ushijima is a prominent player from Shiratorizawa.
notes:
Ushijima is mentioned as a strong player from Shiratorizawa.
He encounters Hinata and Kageyama near Shiratorizawa and allows them to watch a practice.
Ushijima is noted for his strength and presence on the court.
He comments on Oikawa's abilities and the strength of his own team.
